post.summary: Create an account and email a code to confirm the address. The answer is the same for any address.
Confirm the address with the emailed code and the sign-up password, and sign in. Sets the refresh cookie.

Send the sign-up email again: a new code, or "you already have an
account" for a confirmed address. The answer is the same for any address.
Sign in. Sets the refresh cookie.
A new access token, from the refresh cookie. Replaces the cookie too: each is used once.
End this session. Always succeeds, and clears the cookie.
End every session of the signed-in user, this one included.

post.summary: Email a code for choosing a new password. The answer is the same for any address.

Choose a new password with the emailed code. Ends every earlier session,
then signs in here: sets a new refresh cookie.

get.summary: How this account signs in: a password, other providers, or both.

post.summary:
For an account without a password (one made with Google): email a code
to set one. 409 AUTH_PASSWORD_ALREADY_SET when it has one.
Set a first password with that code. The account keeps its other sign-in methods, and its sessions.

For deleting an account made with Google, which has no password to
confirm with: email a code. 409 AUTH_USE_PASSWORD for one with a password.

Delete your own account, with proof it is you: the password (or the
emailed code, for an account without one). Every session ends, this one included; the owner is emailed.

parameters.name: redirect
parameters.description: A path of the web app to return to. Default `/`.

get.summary:
Sign in with another provider. Redirects to the provider, and sets a
short-lived cookie that ties its return to this browser.

Where the provider sends the browser back. Signs in and redirects to the
web app's `/auth/callback?redirect=<path>`; if it cannot, to
`/auth/callback?error=cancelled|failed|email_unverified|account_deleted`.

email.description: Absent only for an account whose personal data has been erased.

username.description:
3-25 lowercase letters, digits or underscores. Normalised to lower case
first, so `Alice` and `alice` are the same name. Permanent once set.

bio.description: An empty string clears the bio.

password.description: At least 8 characters with an upper-case letter, a lower-case letter, a digit and a symbol.

access_token.description: Send as `Authorization: Bearer <access_token>`. Keep it in memory only.

expires_in.description: Seconds until it expires. Refresh shortly before.

password.description:
The password the address was signed up with. Signing up again before
confirming replaces it, so only the person who chose the current one can
confirm the address.

code.description: The six digits from the email.

providers.description:
The other providers configured for sign-in, by id (`google`). Empty when
none are. Start one with `GET /auth/<id>`.

code.description: The six digits from the email.

password.description: The account has a password: email-and-password sign-in works. False for one made with Google, until a password is set.

providers.description: Other providers linked to the account, by id (`google`).

password.description: The account's password; for an account that has one.
